Polyair Is Acquired by IPG | Baird
s: (“Polyair”), a portfolio company of Glencoe Capital Management, LLC (“Glencoe”), recently completed its sale to Intertape Polymer Group Inc. (“IPG”) (TSX:ITP), for approximately $146 million.

July 20, 2018 - Intertape Polymer Group Inc. is betting on high growth in e-commerce and will buy all the equity in Polyair Inter Pack Inc., a major producer of protective packaging such as bubble cushioning.

t: Intertape Polymer Group Announces Agreement to Acquire Polyair Inter Pack
s: The acquisition will further strengthen IPG’s product bundle and bring immediate and additional scale of protective packaging solutions. With the diverse set of customers between IPG and Polyair, this enhanced product bundle should facilitate significant cross-selling opportunities as both companies currently sell products through similar distribution and end user customer channels.
